name: local-shop-delivery-platform
description: Ryadom — monorepo for the NestJS backend API, Next.js web panels (admin, store), and shared TypeScript package (Flutter customer app lives separately in apps/mobile_client)
author: Elshodbek Turayev

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@localshop/shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=@localshop/backend && npm run build --workspace=@localshop/backend && npm run build --workspace=@localshop/admin && npm run build --workspace=@localshop/store
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@localshop/shared && npm run lint --workspace=@localshop/admin && npm run lint --workspace=@localshop/store
